verdict.rationale: Figma does not document an open native file format, and a community report says full-fidelity work is "locked up in a proprietary format" with no local file kept unless you export. Designs are still toolable outside the editor through the documented REST API, which can extract any objects, layers and their properties, and has a published OpenAPI spec with TypeScript types. That access depends on the vendor's cloud API rather than a portable file. Missing for 10: an open or documented native file format, offline/local portability without the Figma API, and evidence of third-party tools that read Figma files directly.
